flora.name: Dandelion
flora.identification: Yellow flower head, lobed leaves form a rosette at base, hollow milky stem.
flora.uses: Leaves in salad, roots roasted for 'coffee', flowers for jelly.
flora.caution: Ensure area hasn't been sprayed with pesticides.

flora.name: Stinging Nettle
flora.identification: Serrated leaves, tiny stinging hairs on stems and leaves.
flora.uses: Cooked like spinach (destroys sting), high iron tea, cordage from stems.
flora.caution: Must be cooked/dried. Wear gloves. 'Dock leaf' often grows nearby to soothe stings.

flora.name: Cattail
flora.identification: Tall reed in water, brown 'cigar' seed head.
flora.caution: Ensure water source is not polluted (bio-accumulator). Lookalikes: Iris (toxic).

flora.name: White Willow
flora.identification: Tree near water, lance-shaped leaves with white underside.
flora.uses: Bark contains Salicin (Aspirin). Chew twig for pain/fever relief.
flora.caution: Blood thinner. Do not use if allergic to aspirin.

flora.name: Broadleaf Plantain
flora.identification: Low rosette, oval leaves with distinct parallel ribs.
flora.uses: 'Green Band-Aid'. Chew leaf into poultice for bee stings, bites, and cuts.

flora.name: Yarrow
flora.identification: Feathery fern-like leaves, flat cluster of white flowers.
flora.uses: Styptic (stops bleeding). Pack into deep wounds. Fever reducer tea.
flora.caution: Lookalikes: Hemlock (deadly). Yarrow has feathery leaves, Hemlock has carrot-like leaves.

flora.name: Mullein
flora.identification: Tall stalk (year 2), fuzzy soft 'lamb's ear' leaves.
flora.uses: Leaves for respiratory tea (filter hairs). Flower stalk dip in fat for torch. 'Cowboy Toilet Paper'.
flora.caution: Tiny hairs can irritate throat - ensure tea is filtered well.

flora.name: White Pine
flora.identification: Needles in bundles of 5. Long cones.
flora.uses: Needle tea (Vitamin C). Resin for glue/fire starter. Inner bark (famine food).
flora.caution: Lookalike: Yew (flat needles, red berries) is DEADLY.

flora.name: Jewelweed
flora.identification: Tall, translucent stem, orange trumpet flowers. Grows near Poison Ivy.
flora.uses: The Antidote. Crush stem juice onto Poison Ivy rash immediately.

flora.name: Poison Hemlock
flora.identification: Purple splotches on smooth hairless stem. Fern-like leaves. White umbrella flowers.
flora.caution: Do not touch. Can be fatal if eaten (mistaken for wild carrot).

flora.name: Poison Ivy
flora.identification: Leaves of three, shiny. vine or shrub. 'Hairy' vine on trees.
flora.caution: Oil (Urushiol) causes blistering rash. Wash with cold water and soap within 15 mins.

fauna.name: Cottontail Rabbit
fauna.notes: Plentiful but low fat ('Rabbit Starvation' risk if eaten exclusively).

fauna.name: Black Bear
fauna.notes: Generally shy but dangerous around cubs or food. Hang food bags 10ft high.

fauna.name: Coyote
fauna.notes: Pack hunter. Scavenger. Keep pets close.

insects.name: Monarch Butterfly
insects.identification: Large orange wings with black veins and white spots.

insects.name: Deer Tick
insects.identification: Size of poppy seed. Reddish-brown back.
insects.notes: Carrier of Lyme Disease. Check creases of body.

insects.name: Mosquito
insects.identification: Small midge-like fly. High pitched whine.
insects.notes: Vector for disease. Breed in standing water.

tracking.name: Deer Track
tracking.description: Heart-shaped. Two toes. 2-3 inches long. Sharp edges indicate freshness.
tracking.gait: Diagonal Walker (Rear foot lands on front track)

tracking.name: Rabbit Track
tracking.description: The 'Y' shape. Two long rear feet land *in front* of two small front feet.

tracking.name: Canine (Coyote/Dog)
tracking.description: Oval shape. 4 toes. Claws visible (X shape between toes).

tracking.name: Feline (Bobcat)
tracking.description: Round shape. 4 toes. NO claws visible (retractable). Asymmetric leading toe.

tracking.name: Raccoon
tracking.description: Looks like a small human hand (5 long fingers).

tracking.name: Scat: Herbivore
tracking.description: Pellets (Deer/Rabbit) or amorphous piles (Cow). Fibrous plant matter visible.

tracking.name: Scat: Carnivore
tracking.description: Tubular, tapered ends. Contains fur/bones. White color indicates high bone content.
